ideas.name: VIX Futures Backwardation and S&P 500
ideas.claim: A negative VIX futures term-structure slope is associated with subsequent S&P 500 returns. The paper examines daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly horizons.
ideas.quote: Our main empirical finding can be summarized in the following dimension: a negative VIX futures term structure indicates oversold stock prices and may signal an attractive buying opportunity.

rules.timeframe: Daily signal; one-day, one-week, one-month and one-quarter forward returns examined
rules.filters: Negative slope estimated by least-squares regression of spot VIX and the seven nearest VIX futures prices against time to maturity

ideas.claimed_result: The negative-slope coefficient was statistically significant at three of four examined horizons, excluding the monthly horizon. The sample covers January 2010 through December 2017.
required_data: Daily closing prices and maturities of the seven nearest VIX futures contracts
